title: 安波節（1番・本調子の基礎練習）
author: Anonymous traditional Ryukyuan classical song; elementary rendering by Music Stack
scope: Classical Aha Bushi first stanza, distinct from the village original song. The 53-cell large-symbol order and lyric positions follow mabui (based on Kawada1965), with small notes and vocal/playing marks omitted. Original app layout, equal beats and MIDI rendering; not an independently composed melody.

rights_basis.fact: mabui classifies this version as classical music and distinguishes the village original text. Its notation page identifies Kawada Matsuo, Ryukyu Bunka Shureikai1965 as the base. Only the traditional large pitch symbols and rests are retained; no right to Kawada’s creative notation/arrangement, modern layout, translation or recording is asserted.
rights_basis.comparison_result: Visually compared the first53 large cells through the lower-couplet instruction with the1993 Nomura-school example. The traditional contour/rest order agrees, including the opening 工七五工中合工合工. Small intra-cell ornaments, vocal marks, portamento, original spacing and layout are excluded. The university page also contains an extra following-cycle lead-in; it is not an additional source for the app’s cell layout.

comparison_sources.use: Direct source of the53 large-cell order and lyric positions; mabui identifies Kawada1965 as its base.
Traditional Nomura-school contour comparison, first53 large cells; ornaments and layout not copied.

changes: The53-cell order and first-stanza lyric positions were entered from mabui’s score, based on Kawada1965, not independently invented. The same traditional large-symbol contour was checked against the1993 Nomura-school teaching example p265. Repeat the basic cycle for the lower couplet. Omit small ornaments/Hari and arrange one cell per beat. Singing starts are shifted from rest9/62 to sounding beat8/61 for this exercise. Readings follow ks-sanshin; explanations and app rendering are newly written.
lyrics: Classical first stanza from mabui’s public text, also shown in the1993 paper. Readings follow ks-sanshin. No village original stanza or additional lyric is added.
license_scope: CC0 covers only Music Stack’s new MIDI rendering, equal-beat app alignment and original explanations. It does not license source editions, author-specific marks, modern readings/arrangements, translations or recordings.
